name: loystudiolab-ui
howToUse: 1) Find your intent below. 2) Read that item in manifest.json (props, do/don't, example). 3) Install with the registry. 4) Run lsl-doctor.

intents.intent: Start a new app or add the library to an existing one
Page frame with header, footer, skip link
Numbered section heading (01 What we do)
The single most important call to action on the page
A self-contained item (a case, a person)
Mark work as Studio or Lab, people as Loy
Facts about a project (client, year, status)
Choose one of 2 to 4 options with hints
Inline note or warning in content
Nothing to show yet / failed to load / 404

items.name: foundation
items.title: Foundation
items.purpose: Tokens, global base styles, surfaces, focus ring, type classes and motion for every LoyStudioLab app. Install first.

items.name: doctor
items.title: lsl-doctor
items.purpose: Checks an app against the LoyStudioLab rules and reports violations by rule ID. Run it before you finish any UI task.

items.name: accent-budget
items.title: AccentBudget
items.purpose: Dev-only console warning when a page renders more than one accent (butter) CTA.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.purpose: Trigger an action, or style a link as a button with asChild.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.purpose: Single-line text entry. Always inside a Field.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.purpose: Multi-line text entry. Always inside a Field; pass maxLength and count to Field for a counter.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.purpose: Uppercase UI label for a control. Field renders it for you.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.purpose: Choose one option from a list of five or more.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.purpose: A yes or no choice, or several independent choices.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: RadioGroup
items.purpose: One choice from a short list, as square radios (circles mean Loy, rule S2).

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.purpose: Turn a setting on or off, applied immediately.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.purpose: A short uppercase tag: category, count, state.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.purpose: A flat 2px-ruled container for one item: a case, a person, a setting group.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.purpose: A panel that slides in from an edge: mobile menu, filters, details.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.purpose: A 2px rule between regions.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Toaster
items.purpose: Short, transient confirmation messages (toast). Mount <Toaster /> once.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.purpose: Placeholder block while content loads. Pulses opacity, no shimmer.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.purpose: A short hint on hover or focus for an icon or abbreviation.

items.name: mark
items.title: Mark, AssemblingMark, Logo
items.purpose: The LoyStudioLab mark and wordmark lockups. INTERIM geometry until the final logo is delivered.

items.name: glyph
items.title: Glyph, LayerTag, LayerLegend, FounderMonogram
items.purpose: The three layer marks (Loy circle, Studio square, Lab hollow triangle) and the tags, legend and founder monogram built from them.

items.name: layout
items.title: Layout: Container, Section, Stack, Cluster, Grid, RuledGrid, TitleBlock, Divider
items.purpose: Page bands with surfaces, base-8 spacing stacks, responsive grids and the exposed ruled grid.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography: Heading, Display, Eyebrow, Lead, Text, TextLink
items.purpose: The type scale as components. Heading level (semantics) and size (looks) are separate.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: IconButton, ButtonGroup
items.purpose: An icon-only button with a required accessible label, and a row of buttons.

items.name: field
items.title: Field, FieldError, FormAlert, FormSuccess, Honeypot
items.purpose: Wires label, hint, error and character count to a control, plus form-level error, success and anti-bot pieces.

items.name: radio-tiles
items.title: RadioTiles
items.purpose: Two to four options drawn as ruled tiles with a hint each. The selected tile inverts to ink.

items.name: site-header
items.title: SiteHeader
items.purpose: Sticky site header: logo, section or page links with the butter active underline, a plain CTA, and a full-height mobile menu.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: SiteFooter
items.purpose: Footer on paper-alt with logo, tagline, email, site links and the marks legend. Needs react-router (inside <BrowserRouter>).

items.name: site-shell
items.title: SiteShell, SkipLink
items.purpose: Page frame with landmarks: skip link, header, <main id="main">, footer.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs, NavLink
items.purpose: Where-am-I trail for nested pages, and a standalone nav link with the butter active underline. Needs react-router.

items.name: data-display
items.title: TopRuleCard, MetaList, StatusBadge, Avatar
items.purpose: Small display patterns: parallel items with a top rule, term/detail lists, workflow status, square avatars.

items.name: status-icon
items.title: StatusIcon
items.purpose: Square-framed status marks: info, success, warning, error, pending.

items.name: feedback
items.title: Callout, LinearLoader, EmptyState, ErrorState, NotFound
items.purpose: Inline messages, progress, and the empty, error and not-found states.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal, Rise
items.purpose: The two motion primitives: a fail-safe scroll reveal and a one-time hero entrance. CSS only.

items.name: section-nav
items.title: useGoToSection, useActiveSection
items.purpose: In-page navigation: smooth jump that moves focus to the section heading, and active-section tracking for the header.

items.name: use-document-title
items.title: useDocumentTitle
items.purpose: Sets the browser title as "Page · LoyStudioLab".

items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: useReducedMotion
items.purpose: True when the user asked for reduced motion; updates live.

items.name: field-context
items.title: FieldContext
items.purpose: Lets Field pass its id and aria wiring to controls nested deeper than its direct child (SelectTrigger).

items.name: format
items.title: formatNOK, formatNumber, formatDate
items.purpose: Money, number and date formatting: English copy, Norwegian conventions (2 500 kr, 1 234,5, 11.11.2026).

rules: C1: One accent (butter) CTA per page, maximum.
C2: Butter is never a surface. Allowed only for: the accent CTA, the Studio glyph/square in the mark, hover underlines, focus rings, text selection.
C3: Petrol marks the Loy layer only (founder monograms, Loy tags).
C4: Signal teal only where something is computing or AI-generated. Never decoration.
C5: Text must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1). Concrete, butter, ochre and signal are never text on paper. Use ink-2 for secondary text, brick-deep for errors on paper-alt, signal-ink for Signal text.
C6: No raw hex or arbitrary color classes in app code. Tokens only.
S1: Solid circle = Loy, solid square = Studio, hollow triangle = Lab. These shapes mean nothing else.
S2: No circular or triangular UI chrome: square avatars (except founders), square radios, linear loaders instead of ring spinners, no pie or donut charts.
S3: Status icons are square-framed (StatusIcon). Never lucide CircleCheck, AlertTriangle, Info or XCircle.
G1: Radius 0 everywhere.
G2: Meaningful boundaries are 2px ink (or the surface's line color). The rule color #D8D2C2 is for decorative inner dividers only.
G3: No shadows. Overlays use a 2px border and an ink scrim.
G4: No gradients (including skeleton shimmer).
G5: Base-8 spacing. Use Stack/Cluster/Grid gap steps; half-steps (4px, 12px) only in tight UI.
T1: Jost for display and headings, Archivo for body and UI. No other families.
T2: Heading levels are semantic and sequential (one h1, no skips). Visual size is a separate prop.
T3: Fonts load via <link> in index.html with preconnect, never CSS @import.
T4: Use the fluid type scale (display, h1, h2, h3, lead, body, small, eyebrow, label). No ad-hoc font sizes for headings.
A1: AA contrast for all text and UI boundaries.
A2: Visible focus: butter ring hugging the element plus an ink (or paper) outline. Never remove focus styles.
A3: Everything works with a keyboard; icon-only controls have labels.
A4: Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
A5: Every control has a visible label; errors are linked with aria-describedby; focus moves to the first invalid field, the error alert or the success heading.
A6: Skip link, landmarks (header, main, footer, nav labels) and a unique document title on every page.
A7: Touch targets at least 44px.
A8: Every image has alt text; alt="" only when purely decorative.
M1: Motion explains (assembly, state change, reveal). It never decorates or loops, except the Signal computing indicator.
M2: CSS only, durations 150/250/550ms, easing cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1). No framer-motion.
M3: Reveals are fail-safe: content is visible unless an IntersectionObserver has proven it runs.
W1: All UI copy in English.
W2: No em dashes. Use periods, commas or colons.
W3: No superlatives or hype (best, leading, revolutionary, cutting-edge, seamless, world-class, game-changing).
W4: No stats as flex, no invented numbers.
W5: Real assets over recreations: real screenshots, real quotes, real clients only.
W6: Copy lives in a data file (src/data/content.js), not inside components.
